texts: mixed: the per-cauldron rule, the yielded vessel and the mire-essence complement all come through, but the parse also states flatly that the vessel is full — "partly" survives only in a side atom, so a check of "is the vessel full?" wrongly answers yes. The hedge ought to cancel that flat claim the way "almost full" does, so the sentence is encodable as written and a re-parse should fix it. If you would rather not depend on that, drop the hedged adjective and state both halves as plain positive properties: "Each cauldron yields an unfilled vessel that holds mire-essence."
